keywords.title: Role keywords
keywords.description: Roles to look for, e.g. "sales", "account executive", "machine learning engineer" (case-insensitive). A company counts a job when a keyword is in its title (ranked first) or, with the default scope, its department or team. Leave empty to count all open jobs.

keywordScope.title: Keyword scope
keywordScope.description: title: the keyword must be in the job title. title_and_department (default): title, department or team. title_and_description: also the first ~1,500 characters of the description (broadest, noisiest).

keywordMatch.title: Keyword match
keywordMatch.description: "any": a job needs at least one keyword. "all": a job needs every keyword.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Only count jobs in these places: city, state, country or region as written in the posting ("Berlin", "California"), or a 2-letter ISO country code ("US", "DE").

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: remote_only: remote jobs only. onsite_only: excludes jobs marked remote (on-site, hybrid and unspecified remain).

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Substring match on department or team, e.g. "engineering", "sales".

minMatchingJobs.title: Minimum matching jobs
minMatchingJobs.description: Only companies with at least this many matching open jobs. Default 1.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only count jobs first published in the last N days. Empty = all open jobs.

excludeCompanies.title: Exclude companies
excludeCompanies.description: Leave out these companies (e.g. your existing customers or your own company): names ("Datadog") or board tokens ("datadog", "greenhouse:datadog").

sortBy.title: Sort by
sortBy.description: matching_jobs: most matching open jobs first. hiring_velocity: highest share of jobs posted in the last 30 days. newest: most recent matching posting first.

maxResults.title: Max companies
maxResults.description: Maximum number of company rows to return (and charge for).
